title: What Is Claude? AI Explained in 60 Seconds
description: Claude explained for complete beginners: what it is, who makes it, and what it can help you with. Follow for a new AI lesson every day. Not affiliated with Anthropic. #ai #claude #learnai #aitips #shorts

scenes.narration: Everyone's talking about Claude. Here's what it actually is, in under a minute.
Claude is an AI assistant made by a company called Anthropic. You talk to it in plain language, a bit like texting a really smart friend, and it answers.

visual.title: *Claude*
visual.subtitle: An AI assistant made by Anthropic

scenes.narration: You can use it to write and edit, explain difficult topics, brainstorm ideas, analyze documents, help with code, and plan just about anything.
Think of it less like a search engine, and more like a collaborator. Instead of a list of links, you get an answer you can shape together.
